split: test seeds 41/53/67 (held-out; E0 results already seen)
note: verifier verdicts are the frozen verifier's (V0-V6); they are not human ground truth

definitions.B4: ungated LLM-only (p4a-v1): window = alert window, else median-time window; decision is the model's
definitions.E1: frozen E0 ranking/localization + p4a-v1 claims; same window rule as B4; diagnosis-level outcome is E0's on that window (E0 receives no LLM input; E1's LLM sees E0's ranking, B4's does not)
definitions.E1-frozen-gated: E1 under the frozen protocol: no alert -> ABSTAIN (equals frozen E0 test outputs)
definitions.E2: E1 + deterministic ownership; diagnosis identical to E1 by construction
definitions.B4-G: hybrid: frozen detector gate, then B4's stored output; not an LLM-only baseline
definitions.E0: frozen deterministic reference on the alert window (already reported in docs/final_results.md)
definitions.unit: the base case (scenario) is the independent unit; views are repeated measures
definitions.top1: DIAGNOSE with the true root as suspected service, over all fault views

counterfactual_call_saving.note: counterfactual: B4's stored calls on gate-silent views were made (B4 is ungated) and are counted as calls B4-G would not make; no new call was run for B4-G

abstention.B4: own DIAGNOSE/ABSTAIN only: a single operating point; no confidence score, no RC curve
